articles.headline: Late Messi assists help Argentina to dramatic semifinal win over England
articles.description: Argentina secure a late victory with two goals in seven minutes, completing the comeback against England and setting up a mouthwatering clash with Spain in the FIFA World Cup final.

articles.headline: Wayne Rooney: England would have lost belief after Tuchel's second-half subs in Argentina World Cup defeat
articles.description: England players will have lost belief at Thomas Tuchel's second-half substitutions in the World Cup semifinal defeat to Argentina, according to former captain Wayne Rooney.

articles.headline: Spain open as favorites to beat Argentina in World Cup final
articles.description: Defending European Champions Spain head to the World Cup final in the same position they were when the tournament kicked off: as favorites to lift the trophy.
